column14: The sharding thing is such an interesting problem.  I'm thinking about the case where a user searches for "A B".  Assume A has a few million matching IDs, B also has few million, and (of course) the indexes for A & B are stored on different servers.  Do you have to pull the full result sets for A & B back to a single aggregator to intersect them?  I'd love to learn more about the optimizations for that problem.
